module: A single place that turns a light record into a scene object, for all tools of the suite. Each light is a night light as soon as it is placed: dark by day, lit after dusk, switched by the environment (core_environment). Provides creation (spawn), update (apply), a flag to ask the environment to rescan the scene again (markDirty) and a lightweight loop to call every frame (flush) that keeps new lights in sync with day and night.
usage:
local lights = extensions.editor_toolUtilities_siteLights
local obj = lights.spawn(folder, 'MyLamp_1', {px = x, py = y, pz = z + 6, glow = lights.TONES.warm, radius = 18, brightness = 2})
-- every frame of the tool:
lights.flush()
notes: Light record: { px, py, pz, glow or col ({r,g,b}), brightness, radius } for a bulb (PointLight); plus { dx, dy, dz, cone } for a spotlight (SpotLight). The class is fixed at creation and must match the record. cone defaults to 70 degrees, inner angle = 0.6 * cone, the range comes from radius (range field).
A record with always = true is lit day and night (a tunnel is dark at noon) and excluded from any day/night switching.
Lights are created with canSave = false and castShadows = false; a light without always starts off (isEnabled false) with nightLight = 1 and is entrusted to the environment.

The environment rescan walks the whole scene (seconds on an urban map): markDirty without an object waits for settleMs = 250 ms of calm; with an object, it is put in the current day/night state without a rescan and followed every 500 ms (followMs).

A nil name leaves the light unnamed, which registers it about 3 ms faster; the environment's dusk pass finds them by id, so it still switches them. An existing light of the same name is deleted before creation.
If the environment has been left without a scan (Lua reload), flush detects it (night but lights not enabled, on two consecutive checks) and requests a rescan again.

TONES.desc: Named tints: warm {1.00, 0.72, 0.34} (sodium), white {1.00, 0.95, 0.88}, cool {0.78, 0.87, 1.00} (metal halide). Prevents two neighboring sites from being lit in different colors.

apply.desc: Adjusts an existing light from a record: radius (or range and angles for a spotlight), brightness, color, shadows disabled, position, and rotation toward (dx, dy, dz) for a spotlight.

spawn.desc: Creates a light object for a record (SpotLight if it carries a direction, otherwise PointLight), registers it under name and adds it to folder. Returns nil if creation fails. Unless always, the light is entrusted to the environment via markDirty.

markDirty.desc: Signals that a light is new (with obj: it will be put in the current day/night state) or that a full scene rescan is due (without obj: done after a 250 ms pause). Deleting a light needs no rescan: the environment ignores those that have vanished.

flush.desc: To be called every frame by each tool that creates lights. Cheap as long as nothing is due: performs the deferred rescan, follows the environment's day/night state (core_environment.getLightState) and switches (setLightEnabled, or instance color for an emissive lens) the marked objects.
